gloss: playfulness; sense of fun; playful spirit

definitions.gloss: playfulness; sense of fun; playful spirit
definitions.explanation: A lighthearted, creative attitude that adds an element of fun or whimsy to something. Often used positively to describe designs, creations, or approaches that incorporate a touch of humor or unconventional charm.

examples.japanese: {遊|あそ}び{心|ごころ}のあるデザインだ。
examples.english: It's a design with a playful touch.

examples.japanese: {料理|りょうり}にも{遊|あそ}び{心|ごころ}を{取|と}り{入|い}れたい。
examples.english: I want to incorporate a sense of fun into my cooking too.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}ばかりではなく、{遊|あそ}び{心|ごころ}を{忘|わす}れないことが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It's important not to forget a sense of playfulness, not just focus on work.

notes:
A compound of {遊|あそ}び (play, fun) and {心|こころ} (heart, spirit), with rendaku changing こころ to ごころ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遊|あそ}び{心|ごころ}がある (to have a playful spirit)
- {遊|あそ}び{心|ごころ}を{忘|わす}れない (to not forget one's sense of fun)
- {遊|あそ}び{心|ごころ}を{取|と}り{入|い}れる (to incorporate playfulness)
- {遊|あそ}び{心|ごころ}{満載|まんさい} (full of playfulness)

A positive, approving term. Used frequently when praising creative work, design, architecture, fashion, or cuisine that goes beyond the purely functional to include an element of delight or surprise. The ～{心|ごころ} suffix pattern also appears in words like {親心|おやごころ} (parental love) and {乙女心|おとめごころ} (maiden's heart).
